title: Intuitive Surgical Q2 2026 earnings release (SEC Exhibit 99.1)
excerpt: Worldwide procedures grew approximately 16%; Q2 revenue was USD 2.89 billion; quarter-end cash, cash equivalents, and investments were USD 8.63 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer exhibit confirms Q2 procedure and installed-base growth, expanding recurring instrument revenue, first-half GAAP earnings, strong liquidity, and tariff-sensitive guidance.
